name: ai-contribution-check
description: GitHub Action that checks pull requests against a repository's AI-contribution policy (.github/ai-policy.yml).
author: Pujitha Paladugu

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && ncc build lib/index.js -o dist --license licenses.txt --target es2023 && rm -rf lib
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
